info.title: Aroha production booking API
info.description: Verified Google identities and active hosts. Shared adult site capacity, day outings, shared sleeping places, private family rooms and host-quoted exclusive events. Existing reservations preserve prices and terms. No online payments. See booking-products-contract.md and contract-notes.md. Profile/contact, continuous event ranges and operational observability are defined in booking-platform-v2.md. API0.7.0 adds isolated pre-production and optional server-configured Resend/private invoices; see preproduction-email-contract.md. Production remains on0.6.0 until separately promoted. API0.8.0 adds published exclusive daily rates and a throttled anonymous aggregate calendar; see booking-refinements-v1.md. Existing legacy event offers retained.
